jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The partner-owned financial services group provides a comprehensive offering for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

We are seeking a diligent and insightful Buy-Side Analyst to join our Research team. You will conduct in-depth fundamental research on companies across developed markets, with a specific focus on Technology, develop comprehensive financial models, and deliver high-conviction investment recommendations to internal stakeholders, especially portfolio managers and advisors. You will report to a senior analyst responsible for Technology research and investments.

Your role

• Assisting the senior Technology equity research analyst covering the Technology sector.
• Taking over some of the existing coverage of the Technology sector.
• Expanding existing coverage of the Technology sector.

• Building and maintaining complex, dynamic financial models to forecast future earnings and returns.
• Conducting management interviews, attending conferences, and interacting with sell side analysts.
• Designing and deploying AI-driven tools and workflows to accelerate and improve idea generation and fundamental research.

• Sourcing and researching investment ideas to be invested in the Technology portfolio.
• Publishing investment content on internal and external platforms.
• Making stock recommendations to internal and external stakeholders.
• Participating in marketing and servicing activities for internal and external stakeholders.

.

Your profile

• University degree: ideally Master’s degree or a postgraduate qualification such as a CFA.
• A minimum of 5 years of equity research experience on the buy side or sell side, in the Technology sector. Prior exposure to an Anglo-Saxon firm is a strong plus.
• Native or equivalent written and spoken English, fluent or better written and spoken French.

• Strong fundamental equity research capabilities with excellent quantitative (but not quant) skills, and a first-principles-based approach to analysis and communication.
• Outstanding written communication skills (investment memos, research notes) and excellent presentation skills to convey complex ideas clearly and convincingly.

• Complete proficiency in Bloomberg (terminal and Excel API), Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; solid working knowledge of VBA.
• Confident and effective user of AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude and similar applications) to enhance research productivity, insight generation and workflow efficiency.

• Independent-minded, intuitive, self-starter personality with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
• Ability to work under pressure and to meet demanding deadlines.
• Must be resident in Switzerland, or willing to relocate.

Applications for candidates without the minimum required experience in the Technology will not be considered and will be rejected automatically. Bloomberg, Excel, VBA, and other specific skills will be tested and evaluated specifically, in writing.

We do not speculate, we invest, if you are unsure about the difference, please don’t apply.

La tua squadra

Pictet Wealth Management combina oltre 200 anni di patrimonio bancario svizzero con competenze di investimento globali. Il gruppo di servizi finanziari di proprietà dei partner offre un'offerta completa per persone e famiglie ricche, tra cui soluzioni di investimento discrezionali e consultive e servizi di ufficio familiare.

Stiamo cercando un diligente e intuitivo Buy-Side Analyst per aderire al nostro team di ricerca. Condurrai ricerche fondamentali approfondite sulle aziende di tutti i mercati sviluppati, con un focus specifico sulla tecnologia, svilupperai modelli finanziari completi, e fornirai raccomandazioni di investimento ad alta concorrenza agli stakeholder interni, in particolare ai responsabili del portafoglio e ai consulenti. Ti riferirai a un analista senior responsabile della ricerca e degli investimenti in tecnologia.

Il tuo ruolo

• Assistere l'analista di ricerca dell'equità tecnologica senior che copre il settore tecnologico.
• Prendendo in esame una parte della copertura esistente del settore tecnologico.
• Ampliamento della copertura esistente del settore tecnologico.

• Costruire e mantenere modelli finanziari complessi e dinamici per prevedere guadagni e rendimenti futuri.
• Condurre colloqui di gestione, partecipare a conferenze, e interagire con gli analisti laterali di vendita.
• Progettazione e distribuzione di strumenti e flussi di lavoro basati su AI per accelerare e migliorare la generazione di idee e la ricerca fondamentale.

• Sourcing e ricerca di idee di investimento da investire nel portafoglio tecnologico.
• Pubblicazione di contenuti di investimento su piattaforme interne ed esterne.
• Promuovere raccomandazioni stock a stakeholder interni ed esterni.
• Partecipazione alle attività di marketing e assistenza per gli stakeholder interni ed esterni.

.

Il tuo profilo

• Laurea universitaria: idealmente laurea o una qualifica post-laurea come un CFA.
• Un minimo di 5 anni di esperienza di ricerca azionaria sul lato di acquisto o di vendita, nel settore tecnologico. L'esposizione precedente ad una ditta anglosassone è un vantaggio forte.
• Originaria o equivalente scritto e parlato inglese, fluente o meglio scritto e parlato francese.

• Forte capacità fondamentali di ricerca azionaria con eccellenti capacità quantitative (ma non quanti) e un approccio basato su principi di analisi e comunicazione.
• Competenze di comunicazione scritta (memoria di investimento, note di ricerca) e eccellenti capacità di presentazione per trasmettere idee complesse in modo chiaro e convincente.

• Completa competenza in Bloomberg (terminal e Excel API), Microsoft Excel e PowerPoint; solida conoscenza di lavoro di VBA.
• Utilizzo sicuro ed efficace degli strumenti AI (ad esempio ChatGPT, Claude e applicazioni simili) per migliorare la produttività della ricerca, la generazione di informazioni e l'efficienza del flusso di lavoro.

• Personalità indipendente, intuitiva, autoprotagonista con un forte senso di proprietà e responsabilità.
• Capacità di lavorare sotto pressione e di rispettare le scadenze.
• Deve essere residente in Svizzera, o disposto a trasferirsi.

Le domande di candidati senza l'esperienza minima richiesta nella tecnologia non saranno considerate e saranno respinte automaticamente. Bloomberg, Excel, VBA e altre abilità specifiche saranno testate e valutate specificamente, per iscritto.

Dein Team

Pictet Wealth Management verbindet mehr als 200 Jahre Schweizer Bankerbe mit globaler Investmentexpertise. Die partnerschaftlich geführte Finanzdienstleistungsgruppe bietet ein umfassendes Angebot für wohlhabende Einzelpersonen und Familien, einschließlich diskretionärer und beratender Anlagelösungen und Family Office-Services.

Wir suchen einen sorgfältigen und aufschlussreichen Buy-Side-Analysten, der unserem Research-Team beitritt. Sie führen eine gründliche Grundlagenforschung zu Unternehmen in entwickelten Märkten durch, mit einem besonderen Schwerpunkt auf Technologie, entwickeln umfassende Finanzmodelle und liefern Anlageempfehlungen mit hoher Überzeugung für interne Stakeholder, insbesondere Portfoliomanager und Berater. Sie berichten an einen Senior Analysten, der für Technologieforschung und Investitionen verantwortlich ist.

• Unterstützung des Senior Technology Equity Research Analysten für den Technologiesektor.
• Übernahme eines Teils der bestehenden Abdeckung des Technologiesektors.
• Erweiterung der bestehenden Abdeckung des Technologiesektors.

• Aufbau und Pflege komplexer, dynamischer Finanzmodelle zur Vorhersage zukünftiger Erträge und Renditen.
• Durchführung von Management-Interviews, Teilnahme an Konferenzen und Interaktion mit Sell Side Analysten.
• Design und Einsatz von KI-gestützten Tools und Workflows zur Beschleunigung und Verbesserung der Ideengenerierung und Grundlagenforschung.

• Beschaffung und Erforschung von Anlageideen, die in das Technologieportfolio investiert werden sollen.
• Veröffentlichung von Anlageinhalten auf internen und externen Plattformen.
• Erstellung von Bestandsempfehlungen für interne und externe Stakeholder.
• Teilnahme an Marketing- und Serviceaktivitäten für interne und externe Stakeholder.

• Universitätsabschluss: Idealerweise Master-Abschluss oder eine postgraduale Qualifikation wie ein CFA.
• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Aktienresearch auf der Kauf- oder Verkaufsseite im Technologiesektor. Eine vorherige Exposition gegenüber einem angelsächsischen Unternehmen ist ein starkes Plus.
• Muttersprachliches oder gleichwertiges geschriebenes und gesprochenes Englisch, fließend oder besser geschriebenes und gesprochenes Französisch.

• Starke grundlegende Equity-Research-Fähigkeiten mit hervorragenden quantitativen (aber nicht quantitativen) Fähigkeiten und einem auf ersten Prinzipien basierenden Analyse- und Kommunikationsansatz.
• Hervorragende schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten (Investmentmemos, Research Notes) und hervorragende Präsentationsfähigkeiten, um komplexe Ideen klar und überzeugend zu vermitteln.

Pictet Wealth Management combine plus de 200 ans d'héritage bancaire suisse avec une expertise en investissement mondial. Le groupe de services financiers appartenant à des partenaires offre une offre complète aux personnes et aux familles riches, y compris des solutions d'investissement discrétionnaires et consultatives et des services de bureau familial.

Nous cherchons à rejoindre notre équipe de recherche avec diligence et perspicacité. Vous effectuerez des recherches fondamentales approfondies sur les entreprises sur les marchés développés, en mettant l'accent sur la technologie, développerez des modèles financiers complets et fournirez des recommandations d'investissement à haute conviction aux intervenants internes, en particulier aux gestionnaires de portefeuille et aux conseillers. Vous ferez rapport à un analyste principal responsable de la recherche et des investissements technologiques.

Votre rôle

• Aider l'analyste principal en recherche sur les fonds propres technologiques dans le secteur de la technologie.
• Prise en charge d'une partie de la couverture existante du secteur de la technologie.
• Élargir la couverture actuelle du secteur de la technologie.

• Construire et maintenir des modèles financiers complexes et dynamiques pour prévoir les gains et les rendements futurs.
• Mener des entrevues de gestion, assister à des conférences et interagir avec des analystes de la vente.
• Concevoir et déployer des outils et des flux de travail axés sur l'IA pour accélérer et améliorer la production d'idées et la recherche fondamentale.

• Sourcing et recherche d'idées d'investissement à investir dans le portefeuille Technologie.
• Publication de contenus d'investissement sur des plateformes internes et externes.
• Faire des recommandations d'inventaire aux intervenants internes et externes.
• Participation à des activités de marketing et de service pour les intervenants internes et externes.

.

Votre profil

• Diplôme universitaire: idéalement Master ou diplôme de troisième cycle comme une CFA.
• Un minimum de 5 ans d'expérience de recherche en actions du côté des achats ou de la vente, dans le secteur de la technologie. Une exposition antérieure à une entreprise anglo-saxonne est un plus fort.
• Natif ou équivalent écrit et parlé anglais, couramment ou mieux écrit et parlé français.

• De solides capacités de recherche en équité fondamentale avec d'excellentes compétences quantitatives (mais pas quantiques) et une approche fondée sur les premiers principes en matière d'analyse et de communication.
• Compétences exceptionnelles en communication écrite (notes d'investissement, notes de recherche) et excellentes compétences en présentation pour transmettre des idées complexes de façon claire et convaincante.

• Compétence complète en Bloomberg (API terminal et Excel), Microsoft Excel et PowerPoint; solide connaissance de travail de VBA.
• Utilisation fiable et efficace d'outils d'IA (p. ex. ChatGPT, Claude et applications similaires) pour améliorer la productivité de la recherche, la production de perspicacité et l'efficacité du workflow.

• Personnalité indépendante, intuitive et autodidacte, avec un fort sentiment d'appropriation et de responsabilité.
• Capacité de travailler sous pression et de respecter des délais exigeants.
• Il doit résider en Suisse ou vouloir déménager.

Les candidatures pour les candidats sans l'expérience minimale requise dans la technologie ne seront pas prises en considération et seront rejetées automatiquement. Bloomberg, Excel, VBA, et d'autres compétences spécifiques seront testés et évalués spécifiquement, par écrit.

Nous ne spéculons pas, nous investissons, si vous n'êtes pas sûr de la différence, s'il vous plaît ne postulez pas.

Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5,400 people.

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 220 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial services group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

You will be joining Pictet Wealth Management Geneva and will be part of the Client Business Compliance (CBC) Monitoring team, based in Geneva.

Your role

As a member of the CBC Monitoring Team, your mission is to support the fight against money laundering and the financing of terrorism, in accordance with regulations such as AMLA, OBA-FINMA and CDB20.
You will perform the various activities carried out by the team, including, among others, transaction monitoring, client screening, correspondent banks’ requests and payment filtering.
Depending on operational needs, you may be asked to assist with other compliance-related activities. You will be entrusted with the following responsibilities :

• Transaction monitoring: Reviewing and analyzing client transactions to detect suspicious or unusual activity.

• Client screening: Conducting due diligence checks on clients to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies.

• Correspondent banks’ requests: Managing and responding to requests from correspondent banks, particularly those related to sanctions and other compliance matters.

• Payment filtering: Screening payments to identify and block transactions that may involve sanctioned individuals, entities or jurisdictions.

• Carrying out and following up on all necessary clarification processes to resolve alerts or issues identified during monitoring activities.

• Ensuring frequent interactions with the Front Office, providing guidance and acting as an advisor on compliance matters.

• Interacting with various internal stakeholders and delivering presentations to the AML Committees as required.

• Taking charge of ad hoc projects related to the team’s activities, under the supervision of the Team Manager.

Your profile

• Minimum 5 years’ experience in a similar compliance position within private banking in Switzerland

• Master’s degree required; a Certificate in Compliance Management is an asset

• Strong interest in regulatory issues and the AML field; very good knowledge of AMLA, OBA-FINMA, the Swiss banks’ code of conduct and related case law

• Excellent command of French and English (oral and written); additional languages are a plus

• Proficient in standard IT tools, including banking software and MS Office

• Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving skills

• Flexible, versatile and conscientious; able to communicate precisely and distil important information

• Able to show discretion and handle confidential matters appropriately

Pictet Tech designs, integrates and operates software applications ranging from portfolio management systems and trading platforms to banking and corporate solutions. The division is responsible for some of the Group’s key innovations while sustaining business operations.

The Tech division and its Analytics platform are looking to hire a Data Engineer to reinforce their team to strengthen the data foundations and services offered to the Group’s business lines.

You will contribute to building and evolving scalable, secure and reliable internal platforms that enable reporting, automation and data-driven services across the division. Working closely with a wide range of stakeholders, you will help deliver robust self-service capabilities, improve developer experience and support the operational and technology teams with modern platform solutions that create tangible business value.

• Identifying and documenting requirements related to process automation, infrastructure evolution, observability and internal developer tooling.

• Using Python, Prefect and DBT to build and orchestrate reliable data pipelines and platform services for ingesting, transforming and serving operational metrics.

• Promoting engineering best practices including CI/CD, infrastructure as code, testing, documentation and platform standardisation.

• Keeping abreast of current trends and advances in platform engineering, cloud-native technologies and automation relevant to the Group’s operational needs.

Your profile

• A Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related field.

• Experience in platform engineering, DevOps or software engineering roles.

• Strong knowledge of SQL, Python and automation frameworks.

• Experience with CI/CD, API-based integrations, infrastructure as code and event-driven architectures.
